name: Xperi Inc.
summary: Xperi Inc. operates as a media and entertainment technology company worldwide. It offers Pay-TV solutions, including user experience solutions servicing Pay-TV operators; and electronic program guides, including TV listings navigation plus integrated video-on-demand and digital video recorder, as well as integrates broadband internet-delivered video directly into the consumer's primary video consumption platform to provide universal search, discovery, and consumption regardless of where the content originates.
